# `progress` (Content)

<!-- GENERATED by `dart run tool/reference.dart`. Do not edit. -->

Progress indicator. Without `value` it spins forever.

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | text | a number from 0 to 1 |
| `circular` | literal | true for a circle |

Kinds are explained in REFERENCE.md (Widgets). Icons, colors and text variants: style.md.
